_design.pattern: append-only CRDT update log per document (SD-16)

items.update: PK=DOC#<draftId> SK=<seq> | update (binary, merged Yjs update of one ~100 ms flush), at

accessPatterns: append: PutItem IF attribute_not_exists(SK) - a second writer for the same doc (split brain during a ring change) fails instead of interleaving
load: Query PK=DOC#d AND SK > snapshotSeq (the tail after the S3 snapshot)
compaction: BatchWriteItem deletes of SK <= snapshotSeq
_design.why: 20k updates/s across 100k docs is append-heavy and key-addressed; partitions are per document and stay small because compaction trims them
